name: Past Liminal
summary:
Past Liminal is an early access **Backrooms** experience that lets you and your friends venture through randomized levels. Every expedition gives you a new path, unlocking new levels and monsters.

Playing more allows you to level up, giving you access to better skins and flashlights.
